# Bharathaksha Foundation

> Empowering individuals and communities through education and healthcare.

## About
Bharathaksha Foundation is dedicated to making a meaningful difference in society by focusing on two twin pillars: Education and Healthcare. We provide comprehensive career guidance and accessible healthcare services to those in need, aiming for inclusive growth and social empowerment.

## Key Pages
- Home: https://www.bharathaksha.org/
- About: https://www.bharathaksha.org/home/about

- Gallery: https://www.bharathaksha.org/home/gallery
- Contact: https://www.bharathaksha.org/home/contact
- Donate: https://www.bharathaksha.org/home/donate

## Projects
- Education and Care: Focusing on career guidance and educational support.
- Healthcare: Providing accessible medical services and support.
- Community Funds: Supporting local communities through financial assistance.
- Local Support: Empowering local initiatives and grassroots development.
